name: Computing Word Origins Quiz
description: Ten questions about where well-known computing words come from.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten multiple-choice questions about where computing words come from, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: Word histories can be debated. These are the well-established stories.
